effects.description: The recipient cannot move or attack, and Passive Skills are disabled.Active Skill cooldowns continue to count down as normal.The recipient will continue to take 125% damage from incoming attacks.

bio: Among the ill-mannered Freeborn, Syzoa is a vision of grace. Always flanked by her attendants, Zap and Zop, she acts as an ambassador to the Free Armada's Small Council, speaking for the sea creatures who dwell in and around Freeport's waters. Do not take her elegance for weakness – her stingers will have you jibbering like a wreck.
